topic: FSU vessel, LNG supply contract, and 2026 commissioning
wiki_text: The terminal's floating storage unit is the Bilbao Knutsen, a 2004-built LNG carrier of about 138,000 m3 owned by Norway's Knutsen Group and converted into a floating storage unit (FSU) by HD Hyundai Marine Solution (in cooperation with China's Huarun Dadong yard). The FSU arrived at Puerto Cortés in September 2025 and is chartered to remain in Honduras for about 18 years. It functions as storage only (not a regasification FSRU), with LNG transmitted onward to the Brassavola combined-cycle power plant (an operating 150 MW thermal facility whose combined-cycle expansion to ~240 MW is under construction). In November 2025, UK-based Centrica Energy signed a 15-year LNG sale-and-purchase agreement with Exodus to supply approximately six LNG cargoes per year via ship-to-ship transfer into the Bilbao Knutsen; the contract is expected to commence in 2026, marking Honduras' first import of natural gas for power generation. The terminal is developed by Genesis Energias, S.A. (Génesis Energías SA).
